name: bookmyshow-platform
description: Multi-Theatre Movie Ticket Booking Platform (BookMyShow Clone) - Complete Monorepo Workspace

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/backend && npm install --prefix apps/customer-frontend && npm install --prefix apps/theatre-dashboard && npm install --prefix apps/admin-dashboard
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,customer,theatre,admin" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue" "npm --prefix apps/backend run dev" "npm --prefix apps/customer-frontend run dev" "npm --prefix apps/theatre-dashboard run dev" "npm --prefix apps/admin-dashboard run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/customer-frontend run build && npm --prefix apps/theatre-dashboard run build && npm --prefix apps/admin-dashboard run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/backend test && npm --prefix apps/customer-frontend test && npm --prefix apps/theatre-dashboard test && npm --prefix apps/admin-dashboard test
